inlines.v: GOOD'MAN, noun A familiar appellation of civility; sometimes used ironically. With you, goodman boy, if you please. 1. A rustic term of compliment; as old goodman Dobson. 2. A familiar appellation of a husband; also, the master of a family. Proverbs 7:19. Matthew 24:43.
